name: CJ Logistics - New Century KS (Cold Storage)

fieldNotes.locationNote: The CJ Logistics New Century cold storage is a brand-new facility (291,000 sq ft, opened Q3 2025) at 27302 W 159th St, New Century KS, immediately west of / adjacent to the Upfield (Flora) production plant at 27080 159th St. The available 2026 Maxar satellite imagery PREDATES construction - the parcel west of the Upfield plant still shows vacant farmland, so the building, docks, gate, and yard cannot be observed. Coordinates and perimeter are a best-effort estimate of the parcel location based on web research and the Upfield plant adjacency.
fieldNotes.railServed: TRUE - web-confirmed. Multiple sources describe this as a rail-served cold storage facility with direct rail access; an active railway runs between the CJ building and the Upfield plant, and finished product moves from the Upfield/Flora plant into the cold storage via an above-ground conveyor bridge built over the rail.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural - the site is in the New Century AirCenter industrial park on the edge of New Century KS, surrounded by farmland and a former airfield; ~4 miles from I-35.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Cannot be determined - building not visible in available imagery. truckCount defaulted to 1 as a placeholder; classification flag set false and listed uncertain.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Cannot be counted - building not visible in available imagery. Web sources do not publish a dock-door count for this facility.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Best-effort estimate (~28 acres) for a ~291,000 sq ft cold storage building plus yard on the parcel west of the Upfield plant; not measured from imagery.
fieldNotes.multiStep: False default - cannot verify. Note the conveyor bridge is a product-transfer link, not a truck checkpoint.
fieldNotes.auditLimitation: Per deep-audit instructions: facility could not be physically audited because it postdates available satellite imagery. Location resolved via web research; physical-yard classification fields are placeholders flagged as uncertain. Recommend re-audit when newer imagery (post-Q3 2025) becomes available.
